title: The exhausted admission-budget preview always names begin_preparation_unacknowledged and counts every automatic attempt since acceptance
outcome: The preview 'automatic re-admission exhausted after N attempts; last cause …' names the actual last cause: a pending prepared Begin (begin_preparation_pending), or the outage code of a bind or admission retry. N counts only the re-admission attempts actually made after the first prepared-Begin hold, never declined drains. The pending card's causal-failure originalCode matches its card code, or the split is documented. Tests cover each cause.
acceptance: The exhausted admission-budget preview always names begin_preparation_unacknowledged and counts every automatic attempt since acceptance is done
